stories.title: Police appeal after counterfeit notes used at Holland & Barrett in Mold
stories.summary: North Wales Police have released an image of a man they want to identify after counterfeit notes were offered as payment at Holland & Barrett in Mold. stories.title: New synthetic opioids found in Welsh drug testing samples for the first time
stories.summary: More than a third of drug samples sent to a Welsh testing service over the past year did not contain the substance the sender thought they had bought, Public Health Wales has said. stories.title: RAC predicts busiest late August bank holiday on the roads since 2015
stories.summary: Around 20 million leisure car trips are expected over the late August bank holiday, the RAC says, in what could be the busiest getaway since its records began in 2015. stories.title: Royal Mint releases first 10p coins bearing King Charles III’s portrait
stories.summary: The first 10p coins to carry King Charles III’s portrait have entered circulation, and every one of them was struck in Wales. stories.title: RNLI Flint asks public to report anyone tampering with life rings after Hawarden Bridge incident
stories.summary: Volunteers at Flint Lifeboat Station cut short a training exercise after finding a life ring tied to Hawarden Bridge and left hanging over the water.
